endpoints.summary: Returns the streams in your workspace, newest first. Results are paginated with a cursor; see [Pagination](/v3/guides/pagination).
query: Number of streams to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
Only return streams in this region, for example `us-west-2`.
errors: The cursor is malformed or older than 24 hours.

endpoints.summary: Creates a stream. Stream names are unique within a workspace and region.
body: Lowercase letters, digits, dots and dashes; 3 to 64 characters.
1 to 256. Defaults to 6. You can raise this later but never lower it.
How long events are kept. 1 to 8,760 depending on your plan.
Validate every event against this schema.
endpoints.response_text: Returns the new stream with status `201 Created`.
errors: A stream with this name already exists in the region.
Your plan does not allow this retention period.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves a stream, including its partition count and current throughput.
errors: No stream with this ID exists in your workspace.

endpoints.summary: Deletes a stream and every event in it. Consumer groups attached to the stream are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
errors: No stream with this ID exists.
Deletion protection is on. Turn it off in the dashboard first.

endpoints.summary: Publishes one event to a stream. For more than a few events per second, use [Publish a batch](/v3/reference/publish-batch).
body: Partition key. Events with the same key go to the same partition in order.
The event payload. At most 1 MB once encoded.
errors: The encoded event is larger than 1 MB.
The event does not match the stream's schema.

endpoints.summary: Publishes up to 500 events in one request. The whole request body may be at most 5 MB. Events in a batch are accepted or rejected individually.
body: 1 to 500 event objects, each shaped like a single publish.
errors: The request body is larger than 5 MB.

endpoints.summary: Reads the next events for a consumer group. Long-polls for up to `wait_ms` when nothing is available.
errors: No consumer group with this ID exists.

endpoints.summary: Creates a consumer group on a stream. A group tracks one committed offset per partition.
errors: A group with this name already exists on the stream.

endpoints.summary: Returns the committed offset and lag for every partition of a consumer group. Replaces `GET /v2/streams/{stream_id}/offsets`.
errors: No consumer group with this ID exists.

endpoints.summary: Commits offsets for one or more partitions. Commits are monotonic: an offset lower than the current commit is ignored unless `force` is true.
body: Allow moving a commit backwards. Defaults to false.
errors: The group rebalanced since you read these events.

endpoints.summary: Registers an HTTPS URL to receive events. The response includes the signing secret once; store it safely.
body: An `https://` URL reachable from the public internet.
Only deliver matching event types, for example `order.*`.

endpoints.summary: Lists webhook endpoints with their status and recent delivery success rate.
Issues a new signing secret. The old secret keeps working for `overlap_hours` so you can deploy the new one.
Lists audit events for the workspace. Available on Business and Enterprise. Events older than your plan's retention period are not returned; see [Audit logs](/v3/platform/audit-logs).
query: Filter by user or API key ID.
errors: Audit logs are not available on your plan.
